title.en: The project root stays small and finite

summary.en: A root filled with loose files is hard to read; content and configuration that could live in directories should not pile up at the top.

en: The project's root was filling up with loose files.
I am sorting them into folders, so it stays easy to find your way around.
fr: La racine du projet se remplissait de fichiers en vrac.
Je les range dans des dossiers, pour qu'on s'y retrouve facilement.

reason.en: The project root holds more entries than the configured limit, which makes the layout hard to read: content and configuration that could live in directories are loose at the top instead. Group related files into directories, and keep the root to the few entries a reader expects. The threshold is configurable per archetype.
